messages:
elaine (docs): just opened PR to add a compact "tool calling" cookbook entry: includes minimal request, JSON-schema, and parse+fallback snippet. would love quick reviews on wording and examples.
nate (eng): thanks — want snippets in py + ts? keeping them tiny is fine. also mention older SDK behavior for parse helpers.
elaine (docs): yes both languages. i'll add a short migration note: 'older SDKs returned raw tool text; use SDK.parseToolOutput or JSON.parse with try/catch'.
ravi (eng-ml): add an example of an optional nested field and nullability. quick schema suggestion:
```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"job":{"type":"string"},"output":{"anyOf":[{"type":"null"},{"type":"object"}]}} ,"required":["job"]}
```
tess (devex): also recommend a validator step: prefer validating with ajv or the SDK's validate helper and log failures rather than throwing. show a fallback object.
elaine (docs): good idea. will include a short code-line showing fallback and logging. nate, can you draft the TS call+parse snippet (2-3 lines)?
nate (eng): sure:
```ts
const r = await client.tools.invoke('summarize', {text});
const body = tryParseJSON(r.output) ?? {summary: null, fallback: true};
```

nate (eng): one-liner for tryParseJSON: `const tryParseJSON = s=>{try{return JSON.parse(s)}catch(e){return null}}`
ravi (eng-ml): wording note on guardrails: explicitly recommend schema-first for high-trust flows, but for exploratory flows allow loose parsing with telemetry enabled to catch regressions.
tess (devex): fix two links flagged by link-bot: old RFC -> /guides/tool-calling, and internal snippet -> /snippets/tool-samples/new.
link-bot: Link-scan: 2 broken links detected in diff: `/rfc/tool-v0` and `/snippets/legacy-tool-sample`.
elaine (docs): i'll swap those before merge. also adding small TOC anchor for "Parsing & Fallback" so readers can jump directly.
nate (eng): tiny nit: standardize on term "tool calling" in this page; add parenthetical about legacy "function calling".
ravi (eng-ml): also add a short pointer to Optimize guide about token impact when including raw JSON in prompts.
link-bot: CI: lint OK, link-scan OK after updates.
elaine (docs): pushed fixes, CI green. merging in 10m unless any last comments. thanks all! :sparkles:
